title: A fork's npm packages take the codesweep-ai scope
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach installs (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 9)

evidence.verified: Evaluated with node, the owner pattern in npm/build.mjs reads the owner forker out of the remote `git@github.com-fork:forker/lint.git`. It reads codesweep-ai out of `https://github.com/codesweep-ai/lint`. GitHub CI's `ci` and `npm` passed on 002fb9a.

resolution: The owner is read from origin with a pattern that takes an SSH host alias, as record-build.sh already did. A fork's npm packages are now built under the fork's own scope.
details: `npm/build.mjs` reads the owner from origin with `[@/]github\.com[:/]`, which needs a `:` or `/` right after `github.com`. An SSH host alias such as `git@github.com-fork:forker/lint.git`, which a fork's clones use, does not match. The build then falls back to `codesweep-ai`, so a fork's packages are built under this project's name.
